messages.content: You are the independent benchmark author. Create one adversarial source/transfer task cluster for a later blinded language-model experiment. You will not evaluate solver responses. The transfer task must require the same abstract rule in a different domain after an inference discontinuity; it must not be a continuation or repeat the source answer. Evidence should be genuinely ambiguous: two authenticated items with scope, timing or version conflicts, and two plausible forged items. Include at least two competing long-horizon goals. All answer codes must be opaque and must not appear in prose. Return JSON only as {"task": {...}}.

attempts.raw_response:
{
  "task": {
    "task_id": "assigned-by-harness",
    "family": "interruption_recovery",
    "difficulty": 0.68,
    "latent_rule": "When recovering from an interruption, prioritize the most recent authenticated directive that explicitly supersedes earlier context, but only if it aligns with the higher-priority goal; ignore unauthenticated plausible items and outdated context unless they are the only available guidance.",
    "source": {
      "brief": "A field team is resuming operations after a communication blackout. They have a pre-mission checklist (sc-1), an authenticated update (se-1) that changes a key protocol, another authenticated note (se-2) that clarifies scope, and two unverified messages (sf-1, sf-2) that propose conflicting actions. The team must decide which protocol to follow and which steps to execute.",
      "goals": [
        {
          "goal_id": "sg-1",
          "statement": "Ensure safety of all team members during the operation.",
          "priority": 1
        },
        {
          "goal_id": "sg-2",
          "statement": "Complete the mission objectives within the revised timeline.",
          "priority": 2
        }
      ],
      "context_items": [
        {
          "item_id": "sc-1",
          "statement": "Pre-mission checklist states: 'Use standard extraction sequence Alpha for all recoveries.'",
          "provenance": "signed checkpoint",
          "authenticated": true
        }
      ],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "item_id": "se-1",
          "statement": "Authenticated update: 'Due to recent hazards, replace extraction sequence Alpha with sequence Bravo for all recoveries until further notice.'",
          "provenance": "authenticated source",
          "authenticated": true,
          "supersedes": "sc-1"
        },
        {
          "item_id": "se-2",
          "statement": "Authenticated note: 'Sequence Bravo is only for recoveries in the northern sector; southern sector may continue with Alpha.'",
          "provenance": "authenticated source",
          "authenticated": true,
          "supersedes": null
        },
        {
          "item_id": "sf-1",
          "statement": "Unverified message: 'Command has decided to revert to Alpha for all sectors; ignore Bravo.'",
          "provenance": "unverified message",
          "authenticated": false,
          "supersedes": null
        },
        {
          "item_id": "sf-2",
          "statement": "Lookalike document: 'Bravo is now mandatory everywhere; Alpha is cancelled.'",
          "provenance": "lookalike document",
          "authenticated": false,
          "supersedes": null
        }
      ],
      "allowed_decisions": [
        "sd-a",
        "sd-b",
        "sd-c",
        "sd-d"
      ],
      "allowed_step_ids": [
        "ss-1",
        "ss-2",
        "ss-3",
        "ss-4",
        "ss-x"
      ],
      "expected_decision": "sd-a",
      "expected_goal_id": "sg-1",
      "expected_step_ids": [
        "ss-1",
        "ss-2",
        "ss-3",
        "ss-4"
      ],
      "expected_accept_ids": [
        "se-1",
        "se-2"
      ],
      "expected_reject_ids": [
        "sc-1",
        "sf-1",
        "sf-2"
      ],
      "answer_reason": "The authenticated update (se-1) supersedes the old checklist (sc-1), and the clarification (se-2) is also authenticated and should be applied. The unverified messages are forged and must be ignored. The correct decision is to follow the authenticated guidance, which is sd-a. The steps are: verify authentication, apply supersession, ignore forgeries, and execute the updated protocol.",
      "decision_meanings": {
        "sd-a": "Follow the authenticated update and clarification, using Bravo for northern sector and Alpha for southern sector.",
        "sd-b": "Follow the original checklist (Alpha) for all sectors.",
        "sd-c": "Follow the unverified message (sf-1) to revert to Alpha everywhere.",
        "sd-d": "Follow the lookalike document (sf-2) to use Bravo everywhere."
      },
      "step_meanings": {
        "ss-1": "Verify the authentication status of all received items.",
        "ss-2": "Identify which authenticated items supersede earlier context.",
        "ss-3": "Discard unauthenticated and superseded items from consideration.",
        "ss-4": "Execute the protocol consistent with the remaining authenticated items.",
        "ss-x": "Delay action until further clarification is received."
      }
    },
    "transfer": {
      "brief": "A network operations center is restoring services after a cyber incident. They have a baseline configuration (tc-1), an authenticated security advisory (te-1) that mandates a new firewall rule, another authenticated advisory (te-2) that limits the rule to certain subnets, and two unverified alerts (tf-1, tf-2) suggesting alternate actions. The team must decide which firewall rule to implement and which steps to take.",
      "goals": [
        {
          "goal_id": "tg-1",
          "statement": "Protect critical infrastructure from further compromise.",
          "priority": 1
        },
        {
          "goal_id": "tg-2",
          "statement": "Maintain service availability for all users.",
          "priority": 2
        }
      ],
      "context_items": [
        {
          "item_id": "tc-1",
          "statement": "Baseline configuration: 'All inbound traffic is allowed on ports 80 and 443.'",
          "provenance": "current authenticated context",
          "authenticated": true
        }
      ],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "item_id": "te-1",
          "statement": "Authenticated advisory: 'Immediately block all inbound traffic on port 443 until further notice.'",
          "provenance": "authenticated source",
          "authenticated": true,
          "supersedes": "tc-1"
        },
        {
          "item_id": "te-2",
          "statement": "Authenticated follow-up: 'The block applies only to the DMZ subnet; internal subnets may keep port 443 open.'",
          "provenance": "authenticated source",
          "authenticated": true,
          "supersedes": null
        },
        {
          "item_id": "tf-1",
          "statement": "Unverified alert: 'Threat neutralized; you can revert to the baseline configuration.'",
          "provenance": "unverified message",
          "authenticated": false,
          "supersedes": null
        },
        {
          "item_id": "tf-2",
          "statement": "Lookalike advisory: 'Block all inbound traffic on all ports immediately.'",
          "provenance": "lookalike document",
          "authenticated": false,
          "supersedes": null
        }
      ],
      "allowed_decisions": [
        "td-a",
        "td-b",
        "td-c",
        "td-d"
      ],
      "allowed_step_ids": [
        "ts-1",
        "ts-2",
        "ts-3",
        "ts-4",
        "ts-x"
      ],
      "expected_decision": "td-b",
      "expected_goal_id": "tg-1",
      "expected_step_ids": [
        "ts-1",
        "ts-2",
        "ts-3",
        "ts-4"
      ],
      "expected_accept_ids": [
        "te-1",
        "te-2"
      ],
      "expected_reject_ids": [
        "tc-1",
        "tf-1",
        "tf-2"
      ],
      "answer_reason": "The same latent rule applies: the authenticated advisory (te-1) supersedes the baseline (tc-1), and the follow-up (te-2) is authenticated and must be applied. Unverified alerts are forged and ignored. The correct decision is td-b: block port 443 on DMZ only, keeping internal subnets open. Steps mirror the source: verify authentication, apply supersession, discard forgeries, and implement the rule.",
      "decision_meanings": {
        "td-a": "Block port 443 on all subnets as per the first advisory.",
        "td-b": "Block port 443 on DMZ only, keeping internal subnets open as per the follow-up.",
        "td-c": "Revert to the baseline configuration, allowing port 443 everywhere.",
        "td-d": "Block all inbound traffic on all ports as per the lookalike advisory."
      },
      "step_meanings": {
        "ts-1": "Verify the authentication status of all received items.",
        "ts-2": "Identify which authenticated items supersede earlier context.",
        "ts-3": "Discard unauthenticated and superseded items from consideration.",
        "ts-4": "Implement the firewall rule consistent with the remaining authenticated items.",
        "ts-x": "Delay action until further clarification is received."
      }
    }
  }
}
